title: JSON API: assets
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_assets', constructed WITHOUT url_prefix; mounted at /api/v1, so every path below starts with /assets). All routes api_auth_required. GET /assets?q=&status=&type=&location_id=&tag=&tag_id=&employee_email=&invoice_id=&warranty_before=&sort= -> 200 list from AssetService.assets.search_assets (tag name resolved via tags.get_by_name -> tag_id; employee_email via EmployeeRepository.get_by_email -> employee_id), each row enriched with 'tags' (TagRepository.for_assets in one query). POST /assets JSON -> 201 service.create(**fields) where JSON keys map 1:1 (asset_tag optional -> generated; 'tags' list of names -> tag_names; invoice_id/invoice_number/location_id/condition/supplier/warranty_until/cost_center accepted); AssetValidationError -> 400 {'error'}; DuplicateAssetTag -> 409; missing type -> 400. GET /assets/<int:id> -> 200 service.get | 404. PATCH /assets/<int:id> -> 200 | 400 | 404 (JSON 'tags' -> tag_names). POST /assets/<int:id>/retire, /assets/<int:id>/lost -> 200 | 400 | 404. GET /assets/export.csv -> text/csv from export_assets_csv (Content-Disposition attachment; filename assets.csv). POST /assets/import.csv (raw CSV body) -> 200 import_assets_csv result dict. Service built with build_asset_service(get_db()).

uses.build_asset_service: src/services/factory.py: build_asset_service(db) -> AssetService (with tags/locations/invoices and tag prefixes from config)
